summary.topology: one Space engine worker per virtual pilot, separated two-plane flight areas

environment.setup: Space server, 64 shared physical cores. Isolated runnable containers for the relay, Postgres, Redis and synthetic clients.
environment.scope: 50 headless simulated pilots with Chapter 04 aircraft and 128 rpm propellers. 25 separated two-aircraft flight areas, 25 simulated seconds, unloaded terrain, and a same-host isolated Docker network.
environment.closedLoop: Simulated workers publish their own live root and propeller poses via the real lease-authorized Space WebSocket route. The partner aircraft is supplied to collision through the production EntityPoseBuffer and applyReplicaBodyPoses path from server messages, sampled at each step.
environment.stepTimer: Wall time for all 50 workers from replica sampling to the physics barrier and outbound WebSocket send enqueue. Asynchronous delivery latency is reported separately.
environment.deliveryP95: Delivered unique same-pair pose updates only. Sender to receiver event, including server scheduling and queuing within the same host. Production pose interpolation delay is tracked separately.
environment.freshnessP95: Time since the last unique same-pair message was received when the next physical sample was requested.
environment.clientCpu: Client/simulation container only, normalized to 64 cores. Relay and datastore container CPU is outside this value.
